book_every_note: QD_REPLAY_BOOK_EVERY frames between WS books. Subscribe echoes the last full book, as the exchange does.

r.primary_queue_age_definition: pending_wait_seconds of ReceiveQueue (oldest frame queued or in parse), sampled every 50ms for the whole window on each group while the socket stays open, not only at a kick or disconnect. series_1s is the max of those samples in each whole second after the window start. primary_queue_wait_ms is the pooled distribution; its p99 is the pass/fail check.
r.failover_gap_definition: failover_gaps_s is seconds from mark_kick, recorded before the 1013 on_close, until that group forwards the next merged event with a higher outbox sequence. It is not ws_continuity.merged_gap_ms and not the hot-primary-failure business_gap flag.
